responsibility: Declares the z/TPF-specific target options layered on top of the S/390 backend, including switches for enabling TPF trace instrumentation and configuring the lowcore hook addresses used by prologue and epilogue tracing, plus the TPF main-object option. It is the option-definition file that feeds GCC’s generated option parser for TPF-only behavior.
same_name_distinction: Within the tpf same-name group, this file is the option-definition table for z/TPF-only switches such as -mtpf-trace and the hook-address parameters. Unlike tpf.h it does not provide OS macro overrides or default constants, and unlike tpf.md it does not encode the emitted tracing instruction patterns.
